article_title: Michael Ryan: Family of Irish plane crash victim awarded $29m in damages

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: A Chicago jury awarded $29m to the family of Michael Ryan after a civil case against Boeing
Boeing announced a new passenger route between Ethiopia and Ireland
The UN World Food Programme purchased a fleet of aircraft
All legal claims from the 737 Max crashes were reopened
tasks.correct_answer: A Chicago jury awarded $29m to the family of Michael Ryan after a civil case against Boeing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עיקר הכתבה הוא פסק הדין האזרחי שבו משפחתו של מייקל ראיין קיבלה פיצויים בסך 29 מיליון דולר בתביעה נגד בואינג.

tasks.prompt: Who brought the civil lawsuit against Boeing?
options: The Ethiopian government
Michael Ryan's widow, Naoise Connolly Ryan
The pilots' training school
The United Nations Security Council
tasks.correct_answer: Michael Ryan's widow, Naoise Connolly Ryan
tasks.explanation_hebrew: את התביעה האזרחית הגישה אלמנתו של מייקל ראיין, נאושה קונולי ראיין.

tasks.prompt: What does “damages” mean in the headline?
options: Physical damage to the aircraft
A list of faults found by engineers
Money awarded as compensation in a legal case
Extra charges paid by airline passengers
tasks.correct_answer: Money awarded as compensation in a legal case
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר משפטי damages הם סכום כסף שנפסק כפיצוי לנפגעים או למשפחתם.

tasks.prompt: Which statement about Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 is correct?
options: It landed safely in Nairobi after a sensor warning
It was a cargo flight carrying food to Liberia
It was the first flight of a newly built airport
It crashed in 2019 shortly after leaving Addis Ababa, killing 157 people
tasks.correct_answer: It crashed in 2019 shortly after leaving Addis Ababa, killing 157 people
tasks.explanation_hebrew: טיסה 302 התרסקה זמן קצר לאחר ההמראה מאדיס אבבה במרץ 2019, וכל 157 האנשים שעל סיפונה נהרגו.

tasks.prompt: Why did the family's lawyers describe the jury verdict as important for accountability?
options: It publicly decided responsibility and compensation instead of ending only in a private settlement
It allowed the family to redesign the aircraft themselves
It transferred control of Boeing to the United Nations
It guaranteed that no aircraft accident could happen again
tasks.correct_answer: It publicly decided responsibility and compensation instead of ending only in a private settlement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשפחה בחרה להגיע להכרעת מושבעים, ולכן האחריות והפיצוי נקבעו בפסק דין פומבי ולא רק בהסדר פרטי.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “unwavering pursuit of justice”, what does “unwavering” mean?
options: Uncertain and frequently changing
Limited to financial questions
Steady and determined
Completed without evidence
tasks.explanation_hebrew: unwavering פירושו יציב ונחוש, בלי לוותר או לסטות מן המטרה.

tasks.prompt: Give three details from the article that show Michael Ryan's humanitarian work had an international reach.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה פרטים מדויקים על תפקידו או על המדינות והמשברים שבהם פעל.
expected_points: He was an engineer working for the UN World Food Programme
He worked during the Ebola crisis in Liberia
He supported work involving Rohingya refugees
His work also took him to countries including Afghanistan, Sri Lanka, Nepal and Ethiopia
He was travelling on a flight from Addis Ababa to Nairobi when he died

tasks.prompt: Summarise the crash, the family's legal action and the outcome of the case.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את מייקל ראיין, התרסקות טיסה 302, התביעה נגד בואינג והפיצוי שנפסק.
expected_points: Michael Ryan was among 157 people killed when Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 crashed in 2019
His widow pursued a civil case against Boeing in Chicago
The case concerned Boeing's responsibility for the 737 Max disaster
A jury awarded the family $29m in damages
The family and lawyers presented the verdict as a step toward accountability

tasks.prompt: How does the faulty-sensor evidence help explain the pilots' difficulty controlling the aircraft?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את שרשרת הסיבה והתוצאה: חיישן פגום, הפעלת מערכת הבטיחות, מאמצי הטייסים והקושי בשליטה ידנית.
expected_points: A faulty sensor triggered the aircraft's anti-stall system
The system repeatedly affected the aircraft's flight path
The pilots tried to disengage the system
They attempted to keep the plane steady manually
The evidence linked a technical failure to the loss of control

tasks.prompt: Using the article, explain two ways a civil trial can provide accountability after a major transport disaster.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג שתי דרכים ולחבר אותן למקרה: בחינת ראיות, קביעה פומבית, פיצוי או לחץ לשיפור בטיחות.
expected_points: A jury can hear and evaluate evidence about a manufacturer's responsibility
A public verdict can formally recognise harm suffered by victims' families
Damages can provide financial compensation for loss
The proceedings can keep safety failures in public view
A judgment can encourage companies to correct dangerous systems
